protocol.frame_zero: actual reset state; source scenario begins at native episode tick 16
protocol.decision_index: zero at reset; one-based recorded decision producing each subsequent tick
protocol.probabilities: original model action probabilities before epsilon exploration, not hit probabilities
protocol.image_sampling: Real RGB at every available physical tick; every physical state retained
protocol.image_fallback: When native state is unavailable, hold the preceding real image; image_tick identifies it
protocol.terminal_playback: Freeze each system at its real terminal transition while the shared clock continues
protocol.shot: Observed decrease in SELECTED_WEAPON_AMMO; an attack decision alone is not a shot
protocol.success: Positive observed kill-count delta before the task deadline

selection.rule: Five outcome-selected test illustrations: a NanoJev-only success with an extended wait before its actual shot, a NanoJev-only success with early turns, a shared success, a NanoJev failure while both baselines succeed, and a shared failure. These illustrations do not estimate aggregate performance; the page also reports every one of the 128 frozen test cases and all 128 OOD cases separately.
selection.aggregate_scope: All 128 frozen test cases; OOD separately uses all 128 frozen OOD cases
